seo_desc: New Brighton has a Santa edition of its Park Discovery Night, and nearby Mounds View lights its tree on December 4.
lede: New Brighton has a Santa edition of its Park Discovery Night, and nearby Mounds View lights its tree on December 4.
celebrates: New Brighton and its neighbor Mounds View keep Christmas to the parks. New Brighton's Park Discovery Nights send families to a city park after dark, and the Santa Edition is at Freedom Park on December 1. Mounds View holds its second annual tree lighting at City Hall Park on December 4. The two cities, with other north suburbs, also run a free Holiday Light Map of home displays that goes live December 4.
lastyear: A local business post describes the inaugural Winter Park Discovery Night at Freedom Park, with visitors in Santa costumes and a large inflatable snowman, so the Santa Edition has run before. Mounds View calls its 2026 tree lighting the second annual, so the first was in 2025. We did not find city recaps.
facts: The Holiday Light Map is a partnership between the cities of Mounds View, New Brighton and other neighbors. Homeowners can submit their address free, prizes go to the top displays, and the Mounds View deadline is December 2.
trains: New Brighton has no train ride of its own that we could verify. The Twin City Model Railroad Museum in Saint Paul runs Night Trains at its museum, listed at tcmrm.org. The CPKC Holiday Train stops in Hastings on December 12 at 8:45 pm, in Cottage Grove on December 13 at 5:15 pm and at Saint Paul Union Depot on December 13 at 7 pm, with free concerts, according to Explore Minnesota. The Minnesota Transportation Museum runs Santa's Train Shop and Caboose Rides at the Jackson Street Roundhouse, 193 Pennsylvania Ave E in Saint Paul, with pictures with Santa on the North Pole Mail Train, caboose rides, crafts and story time from 10 am to 4 pm, according to the museum.
